title: RC FS-BT INS-P And C-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title:**
**Business Consultant -Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Product Knowledge – Guidewire, Duckcreek, Exigent, Majesco. (Preferred Guidewire/Duckcreek)
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.

We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Clinical Training Specialist
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
  
  
Provides clinical training and support to customers, as a subject matter expert, on-site and/or remotely to ensure customer is prepared to operate their equipment according to a minimum of safe and effective use guidelines and to fully utilize the complex functionality of the technology to meet their business needs.
  
  
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
  
  
The role (
**Radiation Therapist**
) involves providing clinical training, application support, and subject matter expertise to customers, both on-site and remotely.
  
  
The Radiation Therapist will ensure safe and effective use of Varian technologies, enabling customers to optimize clinical workflows and leverage the full capabilities of our advanced solutions to meet their operational and patient care goals.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Train, counsel, and support customers in adapting their work procedures and propose new approaches following the installation or implementation of new or upgraded products.
* Develop tailored training programs for customers on the appropriate use of Varian hardware and software products.
* Deliver high-quality on-site or remote training to customers, instructing them on newly installed products, upgrades to existing systems, or other product developments.
* Provide application support for internal product testing activities and participate in ‘Customer Satisfaction Phase’ testing as needed.
* Offer occasional application support for Education, Sales, or Marketing teams, such as Clinical School assistance or customer demonstration support.
* Provide demonstration support at local, regional, and national customer trade events as required.
* Support and participate in the internal training of colleagues when necessary.
* Maintain up-to-date records and handle day-to-day administrative tasks, including timesheets, expense reports, and training reports (as applicable), to ensure accurate and current company data on customer-oriented activities.
* Continuously maintain competencies and complete organizational training in a timely manner, such as Learn4U certifications, internal or external training courses, or on-site hospital visits.
* Attend Health & Safety training to acquire and maintain a strong understanding of national laws and organizational regulations related to workplace health and safety, with a particular focus on travel safety, radiation safety, and electrical safety, and apply this knowledge systematically.

**Job Requirements**

* Fluency in English (both spoken and written).
* Willingness to travel extensively within India, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, including during normal and non-standard hours and days as required to provide optimal support.
* Excellent communication skills; teaching or training experience is a plus.
* 4–8 years of professional clinical experience in radiotherapy, with expertise in Varian Products, such as Oncology Information Systems (ARIA), SGRT, Motion Management and Treatment Delivery.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Windows and Office applications.
* Strong understanding of customers’ clinical needs and requirements.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, coupled with a mature and professional approach.
* In-depth knowledge of modern radiotherapy techniques and their underlying principles.
* Solid understanding of processes and methodologies related to Varian product areas, including product specification, development, expansion, security, and safety.
* High level of self-motivation and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining effective collaboration with the broader team.
* Comfort with working within a horizontal organizational structure.
* Graduation (BSc) in Radiotherapy Technology or a Postgraduate Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology, with 4–8 years of relevant experience.

**Additional Preferred Skills And Knowledge**

* Programming skills in SQL Database.
* Ability to interpret customer concerns and translate them into technical machine-related issues.
* Understanding of the escalation process and ability to effectively utilize it with Senior Application Specialists and Product Managers Basic knowledge of accelerator theory.
* Contribution to team efficiency through high-quality personal work and by positively influencing teammates to meet required standards.
* Strong understanding of team collaboration, paired with effective networking skills.
* Ability to work independently within established guidelines and policies while adhering to corporate procedures.
* Capability to manage workload independently, with excellent communication and relationship-building skills at all levels, both within and outside the organization.
* Agility in being proactive, analytical, results-oriented, and decisive within the scope of the role.
* Ability to actively problem-solve and propose realistic innovations to processes to enhance the customer experience.
* Agile with being pro-active, analytical, results-oriented and able to make decisions within the scope of their role.
* Be able to actively problem solve and suggest realistic innovations to processes towards creating a better customer experience.

**Who we are**
: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.
  
  
**How we work**
: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.
  
  
**Data Privacy**
: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.
  
  
**Beware of Job Scams:**
Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees.  These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information.  If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.
  
  
**To all recruitment agencies**
: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

title: Biomedical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Biomedical Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in biomedical engineering principles and a passion for improving healthcare through technology. As a Biomedical Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining medical devices and equipment that enhance patient care and treatment outcomes. Key Responsibilities: - Collaborate with healthcare professionals to understand their needs and translate them into technical specifications for medical devices. - Design and develop prototypes of biomedical devices, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations. - Conduct testing and validation of medical equipment to ensure safety and effectiveness. - Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to biomedical devices and instrumentation. - Stay updated with the latest advancements in biomedical engineering and incorporate innovative solutions into projects. - Prepare technical documentation and reports for regulatory submissions and internal reviews. Required Skills: - Strong knowledge of biomedical engineering principles and practices. - Proficiency in electronics and instrumentation engineering. - Familiarity with medical device regulations and quality assurance processes. - Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders. This role is suitable for recent graduates or individuals with up to two years of experience in biomedical engineering or related fields. If you are passionate about making a difference in healthcare through engineering, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Engineer
description:

title: USI | FY27 | Audit Services | SAP GITC - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior Consultant, Technology Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance**
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte’s clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
  
  
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Senior consultant, you will build and nurture positive working relationships with Deloitte teams who work with clients with the intention to exceed client expectations. You will:
  
  

* Identify and evaluate complex business/ technological risks, internal controls which mitigate risks, and related opportunities for internal control improvement
* Perform system evaluation and/or audit IT and business process as a part of SOX 404, SSAE 18 or ICFR assessment in accordance with PCAOB/AICPA guidance using Deloitte methodology for whole point
* Perform complete GITC evaluation and testing across IT platform including, operating systems, databases, and network components
* Perform risk assessment for organizations to identify prioritized list of risk/audit
* Perform controls benchmarking to leading internal controls framework to identify gaps and excess controls
* Manage multiple assignments and demonstrate strong people management & networking skills
* Ensure timely completion of activities with quality, complete ownership of deliverables and early escalations to management, if required
* Play substantive/lead role on projects including project planning, economics, and managing quality
* Participate in proposal development efforts
* Assist in technical knowledge development and training efforts
* Demonstrate high level of understanding of internal and external client's business

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree
* MBA in Finance/Accounting /IT/Information security and or CA/CPA/CIA/CISA/CISSP

**Required Skills**

* 4-8 years of relevant work experience, with industry focus a plus
* Strong orientation toward internal control risk assessment, operational, and IT auditing
* Hands on experience on testing of SAP GITC controls(Change Management, Access Security, UAR) Test of design(TOD) and test of operating effectiveness (TOE)
* Have tested SAP Automated controls (3 way match, duplicate invoices, copy controls etc) across SAP ECC, S/4 HANA
* Experience of assessing and reviewing technology risks and controls over areas including access management, change management & computer operations for IT platforms (operating systems, databases, and network components)

title: SAP QM (Quality Management)
description:
Job Description: SAP Quality Management (QM)
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**SAP Quality Management (QM) Consultant**
to design, configure, implement, and support robust SAP QM solutions across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional business stakeholders to translate quality and operational requirements into scalable SAP processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in end-to-end SAP QM functionalities, seamless integration capabilities with adjacent SAP modules, and hands-on experience in S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, enhancements, and production support.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities

Requirements Gathering & Process Design
  
  

* Engage with business stakeholders to analyze, refine, and document business requirements for Quality Management processes.
* Conduct Fit-Gap analysis between current operational workflows and standard SAP functionalities.
* Author detailed Functional Specifications (FS) for custom developments, reports, interfaces, and enhancements (RICEF objects).

SAP QM Core Configuration & Management
  
  

* Configure and maintain core SAP QM master data and functionalities, including:

+ Inspection Plans, Master Inspection Characteristics (MICs), Sampling Procedures, and Schemes.
+ Catalogs, Selected Sets, and Catalog Profiles.
+ Quality Info Records (QIRs) for Vendor Quality Management.

* Configure and support key QM operational workflows:

+ Quality Planning & Quality Inspection (Incoming, In-Process, and Final Inspections).
+ Results Recording, Defect Recording, and Usage Decisions (UD).
+ Quality Notifications, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Action workflows.
+ Quality Certificates creation and processing.

Module Integration & Traceability
  
  

* Ensure seamless cross-module integration between SAP QM and key supply chain/manufacturing modules:

+ Production Planning (PP): In-process inspection lots, routing integrations.
+ Materials Management (MM): Goods receipt inspections, vendor evaluation, stock transfers.
+ Sales & Distribution (SD): Delivery inspections, customer complaints, quality certificates.
+ Plant Maintenance (PM): Calibration inspections and equipment maintenance integration.
+ Extended Warehouse Management (EWM / WM): Warehouse inspection processes, inbound/outbound lot management.

* Oversee and configure Batch Management, including batch determination, classification, and end-to-end material traceability.

Implementation, Testing & Production Support
  
  

* Participate across all project phases: implementation, global rollouts, upgrades, and post-go-live support.
* Execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to build and test custom solutions, reports, and system interfaces.
* Provide incident management, ticket resolution, and root cause analysis within defined SLA timelines.
* Support system governance and project documentation using SAP Solution Manager / ALM.

Training & Documentation
  
  

* Develop detailed end-user documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), business process charts, and training manuals.
* Conduct training sessions and knowledge-transfer workshops for business key users and end-users.
* Required Qualifications & Skills

Functional & Domain Expertise
  
  

* SAP QM Expertise: Proven experience in SAP QM module configuration, maintenance, and support across manufacturing or supply chain environments.
* Core Capabilities: In-depth knowledge of Inspection Types, Inspection Lots, Results Recording, Usage Decisions, Quality Notifications, Quality Certificates, Defect Management, and Quality Info Records.
* Master Data Management: Deep proficiency in Inspection Plans, MICs, Sampling Schemes, Catalogs, and Selected Sets.
* Traceability: Strong understanding of Batch Management, batch classification, and full forward/backward supply chain traceability.
* Domain Knowledge: solid understanding of core manufacturing quality management standards and supply chain operations.

Integration Knowledge
  
  

* Hands-on integration experience between SAP QM and:

+ SAP Production Planning (PP)
+ SAP Materials Management (MM)
+ SAP Sales & Distribution (SD)
+ SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
+ SAP Extended Warehouse Management / Warehouse Management (EWM / WM)

* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA enterprise environments.

Technical & System Exposure
  
  

* Experience writing Functional Specifications (FS) and specifying requirements for RICEF objects.
* Hands-on experience with interface testing and debugging support alongside ABAP teams.
* Proficiency with SAP Solution Manager / Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables within strict SLA timelines in production environments.
* Preferred Experience
* Participation in at least one full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration project.
* Experience in regulated manufacturing environments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, Chemical, or Consumer Goods).

Skills: supply chain,manufacturing,traceability,integration,sap,qm

description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Specialist in this position will perform Web, API and mobile application security testing; validate risks and provide actionable remediation guidance.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. Team

* The Specialist in this position will plan and deliver web, API and mobile VAPT engagements within agreed scope, quality and timelines
* You will perform manual and automated testing; validate findings and eliminate false positives
* And rate vulnerabilities using OWASP, CWE and CVSS, considering exploitability and business impact
* Also, document reproducible evidence, proof-of-concept steps and practical remediation actions
* You will need to retest fixes, confirm closure and record residual risk or exceptions
* And maintain test cases, evidence, reports and engagement records in line with VAPT standards
* Lastly, escalate critical findings and delivery blockers promptly; support critical activities outside business hours when required

* And also, at least six months of hands-on web, API or mobile security testing, including manual testing and scanner validation

description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd | Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
Technical Lead - M365 & EntraID
  
  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Workplace Type: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req32590**
It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
  
  
The Technical Lead in this position will drive Global Governance & Security Step into a global role shaping how Microsoft 365 is secured, governed, and evolved across Linde. Work at the forefront of cloud security, architecture, and Copilot/AI governance to deliver scalable, enterprise services.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Team
  
  
Making an impact. What will you do?
  
  

* You will support, configure, develop, maintain, and monitor M365 Services
* You are expected to work close to EMEA time zone (details to be provided during interview)
* And be responsible for developing, documenting and sustaining the architecture and relevant processes related to M365 services
* You will enforce the creation of technical concept documents, SOPs, and best practices for using M365's different line of products with a focus on M365 governance activities, Tenant Management, Security, and security posture
* Also, provide governance and technical direction and acts as a technical authority on topics related to M365 services
* Analyze and assess business requirements and solutions in the context of M365, keeping in mind security as a fundamental part of the solution
* And handle change management around Microsoft updates to the M365 and Entra ID
* You will support services in line with service-level agreements
* You will also work with Evergreen activities, plan, communicate, and perform the necessary steps to take a new feature or product into a sustainable service offering
* Moreover, support and sustain implementation of Microsoft Purview solutions at Enterprise level including DLP and Sensitivity labels
* Lastly, monitoring the usage of Agentic AI based on Copilot/Copilot Studio in the organization including licensing, costs, and security

Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
  
  

* You must have a bachelor's degree with a major in computer science, information management systems, or business administration and 5 to 10 years+ of experience providing IT application support and administration, including experience leading IT projects
* Along with, 6+ years’ experience with the operation and maintenance of M365 Tenants, including roles as L3 administrator or M365 solution architect
* And 5+ years working as Administrator, Cloud Architect or global development also, 5+ years' experience with PowerShell
* Must have is excellent English skills, both verbally and written
* Also, experience creating technical concepts and driving technical implementations
* Good experience with Power BI, Azure Analytics, and in general with tools that allow creation, managing and analysing data
* Lastly, proven knowledge on Application Access Governance, including graph permissions, and Agentic AI permissions

Why you will love working for us!
  
  
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals & energy, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra-high-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
  
  
Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
  
  
At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
  
  
Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!

title: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L1_2+yrs
description:
**Job Description**
: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L1
  
  
**Position:**
Microsoft 365 / O365 L1 Support Engineer
  
  
**Number of Openings:**
8 Resources
  
  
**Experience:**
1–3 Years (Preferred)
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for Microsoft 365 L1 Support Engineers to provide first-level technical support for Microsoft 365 applications and services. The ideal candidates should have basic knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Intune, along with strong troubleshooting, ticket management, and customer service skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft 365 Support: Provide L1 support for Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* User and Access Management: Handle user account creation, password resets, license assignments, group management, and basic Microsoft Entra ID administration.
* Intune Support: Assist with device onboarding, enrollment, configuration, and basic Microsoft Intune-related issues.
* Outlook and Exchange Troubleshooting: Resolve basic Outlook connectivity, mailbox access, email delivery, and shared mailbox issues.
* Teams Support: Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams login issues, audio/video calling problems, and basic collaboration-related queries.
* SharePoint and OneDrive Support: Assist users with SharePoint access, OneDrive synchronization, file-sharing permissions, and basic application issues.
* Mailbox and Distribution List Management: Manage shared mailbox requests, distribution lists, and user access requests according to approved processes.
* Incident and Service Request Management: Log, track, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs. Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 support teams.
* Ticket Documentation: Maintain accurate ticket updates, troubleshooting records, resolution notes, and knowledge-base articles.
* User Communication: Provide timely updates to end users, follow established support procedures, and ensure a positive user experience.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in IT helpdesk, service desk, or Microsoft 365 support.
* Basic hands-on knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Understanding of user account management, password resets, license assignment, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Intune and device enrollment processes.
* Familiarity with Outlook troubleshooting, mailbox access, email delivery, and Teams connectivity issues.
* Experience using ticketing tools and working within SLA-driven support environments.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and customer service skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of Active Directory fundamentals.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and incident management.
* Microsoft 365 Fundamentals certification (MS-900) or equivalent knowledge.
* Experience working in a structured IT service desk or enterprise support environment.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A customer-focused IT support professional capable of resolving routine Microsoft 365 issues, managing user access requests, documenting incidents accurately, and escalating complex technical problems to the appropriate support teams.
  
  
Skills: l1 support,troubleshooting,microsoft

title: SAP FICA Functional-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Career Family: SAP Utilities**
**Role Type: Functional Consultant**
**The opportunity**
As part of our EY GDS-Utilities team, you will work to implement and support SAP IS-U projects for clients. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problems.
  
  
We’re looking for Senior resources with expertise in
**SAP FI-CA**
to join the EYD GDS team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* To provide functional knowledge with hands-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.
* Hands on experience configuring the IS-U system
* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module
* Design core / customized business processes and provide best practices for ISU.
* Communicate complex requirements to and from Technical and Non-technical stakeholders
* Willing to travel as per requirement
* Monitors the progress and the quality of the project

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should understand different business processes in the Utility Industry (Regulated and Deregulated)
* Should possess SAP FICA knowledge for preparation of business blueprints, business process plan (BPP), functional documents, and test cases etc.
* Should have knowledge of the Meter to Cash
* Should have experience in FICA Dunning procedure/Collection Strategy, payment (cash desk/external cash desk) integration with payment channels, write off, return processing, security deposit, installment plan, and promise to pay.
* Exposure of Country specific localization.
* Experience in BRIM CI FICA is good to have.
* Experience in configuring FICA Events and BRF+ (functional).
* Strong knowledge of clearing strategy, clearing rules.
* Experience in Cash Desk and clarifications.
* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Experience in the de-regulated/Regulated energy market.
* Develop templates and methods to improve the efficiency of application support.
* Gather and prioritize relevant SAP Business requirements and designing the appropriate solution
* Understands configuration dependencies and inter-relationships between other modules of SAP such as Device Management, CS/CRM, Billing and design and troubleshoot in the area with this knowledge
* Define test scenarios to cover full scope of the business as well as creating master data and carry out the unit, cycle and integration tests
* Should be well versed to make enhancements in specific FICA events.
* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands-on experience on FI-CA concepts:

+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc.)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc.
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on integration with third-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:

+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245)

**Technologies and Tools**

* SAP FI-CA / FI-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Tendering Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
operates in a dynamic, project-driven environment that requires careful planning, documentation, and coordination with multiple stakeholders. The organization focuses on delivering competitive, compliant proposals and tenders for a variety of contracts and clients. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their work, maintain high professional standards, and contribute to process improvement. The work culture values reliability, attention to detail, and clear communication across functions to support successful bids and long-term partnerships.

**Role Description**
The Tendering Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end tendering process GEM, EProcure, CPWD & Other State Tender portal, including identifying opportunities, analyzing tender requirements, preparing documentation, and submitting proposals within stipulated timelines. Day-to-day tasks include coordinating with internal teams for technical and commercial inputs, compiling cost estimates, ensuring compliance with client and regulatory requirements, and maintaining tender records. The Tendering Specialist will draft and refine proposals, respond to clarifications, support negotiations, and track outcomes to improve future submissions. The role also involves monitoring relevant procurement portals, maintaining a calendar of bids, and contributing to standard templates and best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Tender Management skills Guide to client GEM Bid Creation, Guide to client GEM L1 Link , including end-to-end bid coordination and documentation control.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret tender documents, evaluate risks, and prepare cost and compliance analyses.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with internal stakeholders and interact professionally with clients and vendors.
* Candidates should possess Proposal Writing skills to develop clear, compelling, and well-structured technical and commercial submissions.
* Relevant experience in PBG,EMD preparation & Return Process
* Proficiency with office productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, presentation software) and online tender portals.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple deadlines, and high attention to detail.
* Capacity to work ethically, follow compliance standards, and maintain accurate records of bids and supporting documents.

title: PRODUCTION SPECIALIST L1
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of the role is to provide effective technical support to the process and actively resolve client issues directly or through timely escalation to meet process SLAs.

͏
**Do**

* **Support process by managing transactions as per required quality standards**
  + Fielding all incoming help requests from clients via telephone and/or emails in a courteous manner
  + Document all pertinent end user identification information, including name, department, contact information and nature of problem or issue
  + Update own availability in the RAVE system to ensure productivity of the process
  + Record, track, and document all queries received, problem-solving steps taken and total successful and unsuccessful resolutions
  + Follow standard processes and procedures to resolve all client queries
  + Resolve client queries as per the SLA s defined in the contract
  + Access and maintain internal knowledge bases, resources and frequently asked questions to aid in and provide effective problem resolution to clients
  + Identify and learn appropriate product details to facilitate better client interaction and troubleshooting
  + Document and analyze call logs to spot most occurring trends to prevent future problems
  + Maintain and update self-help documents for customers to speed up resolution time
  + Identify red flags and escalate serious client issues to Team leader in cases of untimely resolution
  + Ensure all product information and disclosures are given to clients before and after the call/email requests
  + Avoids legal challenges by complying with service agreements

͏

* **Deliver excellent customer service through effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of client queries**
  + Provide product support and resolution to clients by performing a question diagnosis while guiding users through step-by-step solutions
  + Assist clients with navigating around product menus and facilitate better understanding of product features
  + Troubleshoot all client queries in a user-friendly, courteous and professional manner
  + Maintain logs and records of all customer queries as per the standard procedures and guidelines
  + Accurately process and record all incoming call and email using the designated tracking software
  + Offer alternative solutions to clients (where appropriate) with the objective of retaining customers and clients business
  + Organize ideas and effectively communicate oral messages appropriate to listeners and situations
  + Follow up and make scheduled call backs to customers to record feedback and ensure compliance to contract /SLAs

͏

* **Build capability to ensure operational excellence and maintain superior customer service levels of the existing account/client**
  + Undertake product trainings to stay current with product features, changes and updates
  + Enroll in product specific and any other trainings per client requirements/recommendations
  + Partner with team leaders to brainstorm and identify training themes and learning issues to better serve the client
  + Update job knowledge by participating in self learning opportunities and maintaining personal networks

Regional RFQ Specialist
  
  
**Job Description: Regional RFQ Specialist – Explosion Protected Electrical Solutions**
**Role Title:**
Regional RFQ Specialist (Asia Support – India, South East Asia, South Korea, Japan, Australia)
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai, Bangalore or Mumbai, India
  
  
**Department:**
Regional Sales Support
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Sales Director APAC
  
  
**Summary Of Role**
We are seeking a highly detail-oriented, commercially minded, and technically proficient Regional RFQ Specialist to join our team at the Chennai Systems Engineering Centre (SEC). In this role, you will act as the dedicated expert on our Solution Engineering Centre capabilities, supporting regional RFQs and preparing technical/commercial proposals for Asia-based sales teams and customers. You will serve as the crucial technical interface between regional sales organizations, engineering, and production—analyzing complex customer specifications, developing competitive cost estimates, and designing hazardous area/explosion-protected electro-mechanical and LV panel solutions to drive regional business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Tasks**

* Regional Proposal & RFQ Management (Asia Region)
* Act as the central 2nd level technical support interface for the Asia-wide sales network and regional sales organizations.
* Prepare accurate, competitive, and timely cost estimates, technical proposals, and formal RFQ submissions for explosion-protected electro-mechanical solutions and LV electrical panels.
* Ensure all quotations and RFQs are completed accurately and submitted within agreed timelines and regional KPI targets.
* Technical Analysis & Solution Design
* Review and technically qualify customer specifications, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), wiring schematics, mechanical drawings, and international standards.
* Select suitable electrical components, switchgear, and enclosure configurations tailored to specific customer/project requirements in explosive gas or dust environments.
* Develop basic general arrangement (GA) drawings, preliminary solution designs, and detailed Bills of Materials (BOMs) for junction boxes, motor starter panels, and LV panel solutions.
* Perform technical feasibility studies and calculations to support customer quotations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Interface
* Collaborate closely with Regional Sales, Local Engineering, R&D, Product Management, and Production teams to ensure technical and commercial compliance.
* Support regional sales teams in pricing strategies, price-finding situations, and technical query resolution.
* Directly (or via regional sales teams) interact with Asia-based clients to clarify technical requirements and present engineered proposals.

**Role Requirements & Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree, or B.Tech in Electrical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering.
* Experience:
* 5+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales support, electrical panel design, estimation, or costing.
* Prior experience in a 2nd-level technical sales support or pre-sales engineering role for control, instrumentation, or electro-mechanical products is highly preferred.

**Technical Skills & Knowledge**

* Hazardous Area Knowledge: Familiarity with explosion-protected equipment (Ex-d, Ex-e, etc.) and global standards (e.g., IECEx, ATEX) for explosive gas or dust atmospheres.
* Electrical & Mechanical Literacy: Strong ability to read, interpret, and analyze wiring schematics, mechanical drawings, technical specifications, and single-line diagrams (SLDs).
* Product Expertise: Deep understanding of Low Voltage (LV) electrical panels, motor starter panels, switchgear, and junction box configurations.
* Software Proficiency:
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word).
* Knowledge of AutoCAD / 2D Electro-CAD tools or ERP systems is a strong advantage.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Communication: Excellent written and spoken English communication skills; comfortable acting as a regional bridge between engineering and international sales offices.
* Commercial Acumen: Ability to balance technical compliance with cost-effective engineering.
* Detail-Oriented & Organized: Proven ability to manage multiple regional queries simultaneously under tight deadlines.

title: Member
description:
**Company Description**
MeHAN is a human-centered advisory firm focused on closing the gap between buying AI tools and actually using them effectively in organizations. Instead of traditional button-click training, MeHAN addresses the real barriers to AI adoption, such as fear, resistance, leadership gaps, and cultural signals. The company uses diagnostic, data-driven insights tailored to each client’s unique context, avoiding generic best practices. Built specifically for India’s mid-market companies with 100 to 2,000 employees, MeHAN follows a structured four-step process from free pulse checks to custom programs that measurably improve AI adoption. Applicants join a team committed to making AI investments meaningful, practical, and measurable for clients.
  
**Role Description**
As a Member at MeHAN, you will work full time on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area, contributing to diagnostic-led advisory projects that help clients improve AI adoption. You will support the design and delivery of pulse checks and team-wide diagnostics, gather and interpret organizational data, and help translate findings into clear, actionable insights for client teams. You will collaborate with colleagues to shape custom programs that address behavioral, cultural, and leadership barriers to AI usage, and assist in tracking impact and adoption metrics over time. The role involves direct interaction with client stakeholders, participation in workshops and discussions, and ongoing documentation and reporting to ensure clarity, consistency, and measurable outcomes.
  
**Qualifications**

* Ability to understand organizational behavior, culture, and change dynamics, and apply these insights to improve technology adoption.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience working with diagnostic data, surveys, or structured assessments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Comfort working in client-facing environments, with skills in collaboration, facilitation, and building trust across teams.

title: RC FS - BTI INS - Retirement Domain SME-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: Retirement Manager Position**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Working as part of the Consulting team, you will take part in engagements related to a wide range of topics. Some examples of domains in which you will support our clients include the following:
  
  

* Defined Benefits Operations (E.g. - Benefits calculations, Benefits Review), Benefits Calculation for Retirement, Termination, Disability, Death, Divorce.
* ERISA Compliance - US Retirement Plan Testing (ADP & ACP Testing, Corrective Distribution) & Reporting experience.
* Deep understanding of in-plan guaranteed income products such as annuities embedded within defined contribution plans (e.g., target date funds with income guarantees).
* Experience in designing or evaluating protected retirement solutions through insurance-wrapped investment vehicles.
* Exposure to recordkeeping platform enhancements to support in-plan income features, including income projection tools, guarantee tracking, and participant-level income illustrations.
* Money in and Loans -Must have experience in handling money in & Loan related activities, i.e. Check processing, contribution, loan initiation, Loan repayments, re-amortization etc.
* Disbursements: Distributions/Disbursements such as Hardship withdrawals, QDRO, RMD, In-service distributions, loans or experience in processing 401K contribution, loan repayments etc.
* Understanding of business rules of Payout, Qualified/Non-Qualified Plans, Roth Conversion, Roth IRA, Fiduciaries, Defined contribution, Defined Benefits/Pension
* Exposure to Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation (PBGC) study and Public Pensions
* Understanding of plan administration, group and account setup, eligibility
* Understanding of Vesting rules and Investment management
* Knowledge of middle office and back-office processing (retirement account origination, servicing, funds payout, reconciliation of funds, etc.)
* Experience supporting or leading PMO functions for large-scale retirement transformation programs, including project planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and stakeholder reporting

Proven ability to coordinate across business, technology, and vendor teams, ensuring alignment with project timelines, scope, and quality standards in retirement platform implementations or upgrades
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Consulting Skills –**

* Experience in creating business process map for future state architecture, creating WBS for overall conversion strategy, requirement refinement process in multi-vendor engagement.
* Worked on multiple Business transformation and modernization programs.
* Conducted multiple Due-Diligence and Assessment projects as part of Transformation roadmaps to evaluate current state maturity, gaps in functionalities and COTs solution features.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Managing service delivery within the agreed service level across multiple blended processes
* Implement operational governance framework quality review mechanism, communication strategy.

**Technology Skills –**

* Proficient in technology solution architecture, with a focus on designing innovative and effective solutions.
* Experienced in data migration projects, ensuring seamless transfer of data between systems while maintaining data integrity and security.
* Skilled in data analytics, utilizing various tools and techniques to extract insights and drive informed decision-making.
* Strong understanding of data governance principles and best practices, ensuring data quality and compliance.
* Collaborative team player, able to work closely with stakeholders and technical teams to define requirements and implement effective solutions.

Industry certifications (ASPPA/LOMA/ RPF) will be added advantage.
  
  
Experience on these solutions is preferrable.
  
  
ALIS
  
  
OMNI
  
  
Relius
  
  
NeoSpin
  
  
Vitech
  
  
TRAC
  
  
We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
