title: Industrial Engineering And Human Resources Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
BoardLine Spotlight is an independent business and industry intelligence platform that tracks leadership movements, boardroom decisions, and corporate strategies shaping Indian industry. Founded in 2026, the organization focuses on decoding how executive choices influence market dynamics across infrastructure, cement and building materials, logistics, and supply chains. Its insights support stakeholders who need clear, data-driven views of strategic shifts within key sectors. Team members collaborate closely with industry experts and decision-makers to deliver timely, relevant analysis that informs business outcomes.

**Role Description**
The Industrial Engineering and Human Resources Consultant will work on-site in Kolkata under a contract engagement. This role involves analyzing operational workflows, resource utilization, and organizational structures to recommend efficiency improvements across targeted business functions. The consultant will evaluate workforce planning, job roles, and HR policies, and will design interventions that align talent strategies with operational goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting interviews and field studies, gathering and interpreting data, preparing detailed reports and presentations, and collaborating with internal teams to implement recommended process and HR changes. The role also requires supporting change management initiatives and providing advisory input on long-term organizational development plans.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in industrial engineering analysis, including process mapping, workflow optimization, and capacity planning.
* Candidates should possess skills in human resources consulting, such as workforce planning, role design, performance management frameworks, and policy review.
* Candidates should possess skills in data collection and analysis, including use of spreadsheets, basic statistical tools, and report-writing for operational and HR insights.
* Candidates should possess skills in stakeholder collaboration, including conducting interviews, facilitating workshops, and communicating recommendations to leadership.
* Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience in consulting, operations management, or HR business partnering within infrastructure, logistics, or manufacturing sectors is highly beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to work on-site with cross-functional teams, manage multiple projects, and deliver clear, concise documentation and presentations.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and familiarity with change management and organizational development practices.

title: Manager Business Consulting - IT
description:
**Linde South Asia Services Pvt. Ltd. | Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
Manager Business Consulting - IT
  
  
**Kolkata, West Bengal, India | Working Scheme: On-Site | Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE | Reference Code: req33939**
It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
  
  
The Manager Business Consulting will act as a business-facing IT partner by managing the application lifecycle and providing effective post-implementation support for Sales and Supply processes across the RSE region
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Every day is an opportunity: an opportunity to learn, to grow, to share success, and to contribute to one of the world’s leading industrial gas and engineering companies. Seize the opportunity: take your next step with us and join our team.
  
  
Linde values diversity and recognizes the importance of fostering inclusion in our work environment. We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.
  
  
Team
  
  
Making an impact. What will you do?
  
  

* In this role you will participate as a core project team member in the implementation of SAP and non-SAP applications, including system interfaces, across the RSE region
* Further you will own the application development lifecycle for assigned initiatives by working with business users to gather and document requirements, translating them into SAP process designs, developing the functional specifications, configuring SAP solutions, collaborating closely with ABAP developers for custom developments, performing system testing, supporting user acceptance test and ensuring successful deployment.
* Furthermore, you will identify process gaps and propose workarounds where required
* Moreover, you will provide end-to-end SAP application support for Sales and Supply systems across the relevant modules (e.g. SD, MM/PP/PM, Procurement, SAP authorisations, integrated FI/CO areas), including issue troubleshooting, user training, data cleansing and post go-live support
* Further you will maintain accurate and up-to-date system documentation, including business requirements, solution designs, configuration details and user/training manuals
* Moreover, you will act as a business process specialist by maintaining a strong understanding of Sales and Supply processes including OTC, PTP, R2R and master data management
* Additionally, you will collaborate with Global IT teams (including GIMS, BASIS, Release Management, TCOE, Global Business Consulting), Shared Services, regional and country IT teams, and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery and support

Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
  
  

* For this role you will have a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or other disciplines with strong interest in business consulting and a solid understanding of IT and business applications
* Further you have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in system implementations, particularly in SAP SD
* Furthermore, you have a strong business knowledge and understanding of Sales and Supply processes
* Additionally, you have the ability to work in a global environment and travel as required

Why you will love working for us!
  
  
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company, operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
  
  
On the 1st of April 2020, Linde India Limited and Praxair India Private Limited successfully formed a joint venture, LSAS Services Private Limited. This company will provide Operations and Management (O&M) services to both existing organizations, which will continue to operate separately. LSAS carries forward the commitment towards sustainable development, championed by both legacy organizations. It also takes ahead the tradition of the development of processes and technologies that have revolutionized the industrial gases industry, serving a variety of end markets including chemicals & refining, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, and primary metals.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

title: Specialist ADC-Process
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Subject Matter Expert in ADC, candidate should possess following as a minimum
  
  

* Strong Technical Skills in carrying out basic and detailed engineering work. The candidate should be experienced in handling ADC projects including RnD Lab & QC lab.
* Should be able to prepare Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) and Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
* Should have strong knowledge on layout designing of ADC plants
* Should be able to independently carry out Capacity Mapping of ADC Plants
* The candidate should possess sound knowledge on equipment selection criteria for ADC Products from lab scale to commercial scale production.
* Should have knowledge on latest ISPE Guidelines
* Should be aware of regulatory requirements of USFDA, MHRA, WHO, TGA etc.
* Performing All process engineering calculations like heat & mass balance, Utility sizing (Clean & Black), Thermal rating of heat exchangers and hydraulics, line sizing, Pump Hydraulics
* Vendor Document Review
* Reviewing all aspects of design and construction for consistency and safety, including leading HAZOP and PHA Reviews
* Possess thorough knowledge on containment techniques and be able to perform Containment Studies.
* Provide guidance in GMP reviews.
* Containment selection for OEL less than 0.01 mg/m3
* Waste Handling from ADC plants
* Raw Material Handling & Storage

Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Skills And Competencies Required**

* BE Chemical with 15- 25 years Experience in Design Engineering
* Must have experience of design consulting organization either working currently or in the past in Lifesciences Projects
* Experience in Major Peptide projects

Reports to
  
  
DM- Process
  
  
Key India Connections
  
  
India Section Leaders and Technical Leaders providing resource to our projects
  
  
Leadership team/s
  
  
Project Managers, Design Managers, Project Directors, Section Leaders
  
  
Key Connections
  
  
Global Section Leaders and Technical Leaders providing resource to our projects
  
  
Global Integrated Delivery offices providing resource to our projects
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Application Specialist
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As the Application Specialist for Ultrasound, you will be responsible for driving and executing clinical education training, demonstration management, and demonstration strategies. You will facilitate evidence-based practices and support both the customer experience and commercial teams from pre-sale through post-implementation by delivering effective, outcome-based education and training solutions. Your efforts will directly impact our customers’ ability to enhance productivity, improve patient care, and elevate quality by optimizing their technical and clinical competencies, image quality, workflow, and protocol management.
  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Provide technical and clinical leadership during the sales process by demonstrating the full range of Ultrasound products, including potential uses, product capabilities, and customer benefits.
* Coordinate, schedule, and execute objective-based system training for customers and channel partners; monitor and report on training outcomes.
* Develop and deliver product training to customers on equipment usage.
* Monitor customer installations of ultrasound products within the assigned territory/region to enhance customer satisfaction and maintain strong relationships.
* Support trade shows and professional conferences by conducting product demonstrations and customer training sessions.
* Leverage market and product knowledge to assist the sales team in developing effective sales, marketing, and customer service strategies.

title: Intern Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Research Ramp is a specialized publication support organization that helps researchers, PhD scholars, universities, and research institutions successfully publish in internationally indexed journals such as Scopus, Web of Science (WoS), SCI, and SSCI. The team provides end-to-end support including journal selection, manuscript and scientific editing, publication strategy, peer review guidance, formatting, plagiarism guidance, and predatory journal detection. Acting as strategic publication partners rather than generic service providers, Research Ramp focuses on improving manuscript quality and guiding researchers confidently through the publication process. Backed by a panel of over 1,200 PhD-qualified editors, the company supports diverse disciplines across engineering, medical sciences, computer science, life sciences, management, business, humanities, social sciences, and multidisciplinary research. Research Ramp operates with a strong commitment to ethical publishing, confidentiality, and research integrity and is trusted by clients across India and multiple countries in Asia and the Gulf region.

**Role Description**
The Intern Assistant role at Research Ramp is an on-site internship based in Kolkata. The intern will support day-to-day operations by assisting with documentation, data entry, and coordination related to publication projects. Typical tasks include organizing research materials, preparing basic reports, updating project trackers, and communicating with internal team members to follow up on timelines and requirements. The intern may also help with preliminary journal research, proofreading simple documents, and maintaining records in digital tools or spreadsheets. This role offers exposure to academic publishing workflows and requires a professional, detail-oriented approach to administrative and coordination tasks.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks and maintain accurate records.
* Candidates should possess basic research and documentation skills, including the ability to search for information online and summarize findings clearly.
* Candidates should possess good written and verbal communication skills in English for internal coordination and simple professional correspondence.
* Candidates should possess computer literacy, including familiarity with office productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, presentation software) and basic internet research.
* Candidates should possess attention to detail and a careful, methodical approach to data entry, proofreading, and formatting tasks.
* Beneficial qualifications include ongoing or completed undergraduate studies in fields such as English, Communications, Management, or any discipline with exposure to academic work.
* Additional beneficial qualities include a willingness to learn about academic publishing, ethical research practices, and the ability to work collaboratively in an office environment in Kolkata.
* Stipend - 8-0k INR / Month

description:

**Key Responsibilities**

* Pre-Sales & Business Development Support
* Support Founders and Sales Leaders throughout the full sales lifecycle
* Coordinate customer presentations, technical proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, concept notes, and solution documents
* Work with Engineering, Product, and Delivery teams to gather technical inputs for proposals

* Coordinate customer demonstrations, PoCs, and strategic meetings
* Conduct market, customer, and competitor research
* Track strategic opportunities and follow-ups until closure
* Tender Management & e-Procurement
* Identify, track, and evaluate relevant government and institutional tenders across e-procurement portals — GeM, CPP Procurement Portal, MSTC, state portals (e-Tender WB, APTS, KTPP, eProcure, etc.)

* Coordinate with Finance for EMD / Bank Guarantee / SD arrangements and ensure timely submission
* Prepare and compile all required documents for tender submission — technical bid, price bid, company credentials, certifications, and compliance statements
* Maintain and update tender tracking registers (ongoing, submitted, awarded, lost) with status and follow-up actions
* Monitor e-procurement portal portals and client websites for relevant tender notices — IoT, CAAQMS, environmental monitoring, smart infrastructure, IIoT sectors
* Liaise with government departments, PSUs, and institutional clients for tender clarifications, corrigendum updates, and bid openings
* Maintain login credentials, DSC (Digital Signature Certificate) renewals, portal registrations, and vendor empanelments
* Coordinate with technical and legal teams to ensure all responses to pre-qualification questionnaires and technical queries are accurate and submitted on time
* Analyse lost tenders for lessons learned and support improvement of future bid strategies
* Maintain a repository of standard tender documents, pre-qualified certifications, and company credentials ready for rapid deployment
* Customer & Sales Operations
* Coordinate customer communications, documentation, and project discussions
* Support contract review by highlighting commercial, technical, and operational aspects
* Maintain CRM, opportunity trackers, and sales dashboards
* Coordinate seamless handover from Sales to Delivery
* Cross-Functional Program Management
* Drive execution across strategic initiatives
* Track deliverables, dependencies, and timelines
* Identify bottlenecks and escalate proactively
* Continuously improve internal coordination processes

**Requirements**

* Good hands-on experience working with Government clients
* Hands-on experience in bidding and government bidding portal/site management
* Experience in preparing deal collateral
* Notice Period: Immediate or shorter notice period preferred
* Language Skills: Bengali fluency is essential; must be fluent in English with strong vocal command for presentations

**Preferred Qualifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech with MBA — Mandatory

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Tax Consultant II**
Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and help clients improve cross-border trade operations through Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) solutions. This role focuses on translating global trade compliance, logistics, and business requirements into scalable Oracle GTM configurations, workflows, and integrations. You will support compliant and efficient trade processes across areas such as screening, classification, licensing, duty and tax determination, documentation, and reporting. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, compliance, and process transformation in a global environment.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Tax Consultant II on the Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Lead workshops, document trade processes, define business rules, and create functional specifications, user stories, process maps, test scenarios, and traceability artifacts.
* Configure Oracle GTM objects, business rules, workflows, approvals, notifications, exception handling, role-based access, and audit requirements.
* Design and validate integrations between Oracle GTM and enterprise systems, support data mappings and governance, and assist with data conversion and migration activities.
* Plan and execute system integration testing, user acceptance testing, compliance scenario testing, defect resolution, cutover support, and hypercare activities.
* Develop standard operating procedures, training materials, compliance reporting outputs, and audit support documentation for operational and compliance teams.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Oracle and trade transformation teams help organizations improve the way they manage global trade compliance, customs readiness, and cross-border operations through technology-enabled solutions. The team works across business, compliance, and technology stakeholders to design and implement scalable processes that support accuracy, control, and operational efficiency. Professionals in this area support complex transformation programs involving enterprise systems, data, and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 2-4 years of hands-on experience implementing or supporting Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) in a functional or techno-functional capacity.
* Experience with restricted party screening, sanctions or embargo compliance, import or export compliance, export controls, Harmonized System or Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification, country of origin, valuation concepts, licensing controls, or free trade agreement and preference concepts.
* Experience translating compliance policy into system-enforceable rules and workflows.
* Experience documenting business requirements, functional requirements, user stories, process diagrams, and test scripts.
* Experience with APIs, flat files, middleware, data mapping, or error handling for system integrations.
* Knowledge of cross-border trade process flows across order, ship, invoice, customs, logistics, and returns.
* Experience with data analysis, reconciliation, and defect triage.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud or similar middleware platforms.
* Familiarity with Oracle ecosystem integrations, including enterprise resource planning or supply chain systems.
* Experience with multi-country or global trade programs and complex organizational structures.
* Experience with broker or filing provider integrations.
* Experience modernizing trade compliance operating models and master data governance.
* Prior consulting delivery experience, including estimation, RAID logs, status reporting, or client leadership.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting – EY Comply: Position: Senior – Regulatory Reporting**
At EY, we’re all in to help shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service focuses on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery, and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a skilled Senior Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
* Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the client’s operating model.
* Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
* Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
* Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controls—including maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
* Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
* Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
* Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
* Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
* Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* 4–6 years of relevant experience, including 2–3 years in a senior role within regulatory reporting or financial services.

description:

DSS Takara Bio India is a joint venture between DSS Imagetech Pvt. Ltd. and Takara Bio Inc. established in 2011 to bring world-class quality molecular biology tools and research kits to the doorstep of the Indian scientific community, making them readily available and affordable in the Indian biotechnology market.

At present, we are manufacturing Takara Bio branded routine molecular biology products in India at our manufacturing unit located in New Delhi.

This role includes conducting operational and technical training for clients and working closely with Sales, Marketing, and Key Account Management to ensure customer needs are met. * Provide quick and accurate resolution to query/complaints

* Participate in conferences and roadshows when conducted
* Takes an active role in ensuring that any escalation is handled promptly and effectively
* Be a reference point for the entire regional team on various application topics and is able to resolve most of the items escalated

* Make routine visits to customers and dealers and generate leads for business development
* Update competitor activity/promotions to PM as monthly plan
* Capture the initial complaint in CRM within stipulated TAT
* Gather necessary details as quickly as possible to identify the root cause.
* Ensure timely closure and resolution of complaints.

**Job Specification:**

**Candidate must have:**

* Enthusiasm for the Life Sciences Research Field
* Customer Focus Approach
* Action-oriented and good decision-making ability
* Team Player & Good Communication Skills—Verbal & written
* Continuous and Versatile Learner
* Good customer service attitude and willingness to travel extensively

**Qualification**

* M.SC / M. Tech.- Biotechnology/Life Sciences

4–8 years of experience in technologies such as cell and gene therapy, next-generation sequencing, viral transduction, molecular biology techniques, and protein research.

(If Any):

* Excellent cross-functional communication and interpersonal Skills
* Proven research skills in the Life Sciences stream are preferable
* Strong understanding of biotech trends, technologies, and market dynamics
* Self Motivated

title: Tendering Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nu Calcutta Construction Company (NCCC), founded in 1993, is an Indian\-origin firm headquartered in Kolkata and recognized as a market leader in industrial lining works, including refractory, insulation, chimney/borosilicate lining, fireproofing, and AR lining. The company’s strength lies in its long\-tenured employees and workforces deployed across India, reflecting a strong culture of commitment and expertise. NCCC is led by its founding partners, who collectively bring decades of experience from leading global and national institutions and industries. With a blend of seasoned leadership and next\-generation management talent, the firm is focused on sustainable, exponential growth in the industrial sector. NCCC offers team members the opportunity to contribute to complex, large\-scale industrial projects within a growing, family\-oriented organization.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Tendering Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The role involves managing the end\-to\-end tendering process, including identifying relevant tenders, reviewing tender documents, preparing proposals, and ensuring timely submission in line with client and regulatory requirements. The Tendering Specialist will collaborate with engineering, procurement, finance, and leadership teams to gather technical and commercial inputs, clarify tender queries, and develop competitive bids. Daily responsibilities include analyzing tender specifications, estimating costs, coordinating supplier quotations, maintaining tender documentation, and tracking tender outcomes for continuous improvement. The role also requires maintaining updated knowledge of market conditions, client requirements, and industry standards to help the company win projects in industrial lining and related services.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong tender management and procurement skills, including experience in end\-to\-end bid preparation, vendor coordination, and compliance with tender requirements.
* Excellent analytical skills to review technical and commercial tender documents, estimate costs, and evaluate risks and competitiveness.
* Effective communication and proposal writing skills to prepare clear, accurate, and persuasive technical and commercial submissions.
* Relevant experience in construction, industrial services, engineering, or related sectors; familiarity with industrial lining or similar works is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, commerce, or a related discipline; advanced qualifications in project management or procurement are beneficial.
* Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel and Word) and comfort working with tender portals and documentation management systems.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work under time\-sensitive tender deadlines.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams on\-site in the Kolkata metropolitan area and maintain professional relationships with clients and vendors.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS FAAS (Controllership Transformation) \- Senior position**
 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provide advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced professional with strong focus on Enterprise Performance management (EPM) areas to join EY FAAS team. The ideal candidate will bring subject matter expertise in FP\&A and/or Consolidation \& Reporting processes to enhance our FAAS services.
   

  

 Within EY FAAS practice, the Finance Transformation Experts team build and develop client relationship with our regional stakeholders. We are part of an integrated global network of professionals who develop, design and optimise client service business processes for efficiency and high performance. We leverage and improve various frameworks, methodologies, solutions specific to our offerings and articulate presentations that communicate proposals, strategies, plans and outcomes.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Delivery and Subject Matter Expertise \-
+ Working with clients to understand business challenges and identify solution to drive desired outcomes
+ Performing current state assessment of client accounting, reporting, and reconciliation
+ Developing system requirements, designing, user acceptance test stories, training, defining support procedure and implementing with specific focus on Workiva Wdesk, Wdata and integration with data source system/s
+ Mapping data flow and to identify optimal design and governance option as well as potential risk
+ Using Wdata \& Wdesk to create templates, connections, data flows, integrations, etc
+ Focus accounting and finance domain area of reporting and data management including financial, management regulatory reporting, internal controls, global statutory reporting
+ Redesign processes to eliminate inefficiencies and incorporate best practices
+ Stay updated with the latest industry trends, regulations, and advancements in reporting optimization process, sharing knowledge and insights with the team
+ Support project management activities, including project planning, resource allocation, and monitoring project progress
+ Proficient in developing KPIs, performance value driver analysis, and implementing Driver based planning models
+ Develop detailed documentation and deliver training programs and workshops to enhance end user understanding and proficiency in Reporting solution during the handover


* Business Development \& Solution Development \-
+ Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements \& formulate that in solutions
+ Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
+ Lead proposal development or lead proposal teams
+ Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship and drive business growth for EY
+ Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
+ Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
+ Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Business Skills and Knowledge –
+ Strong business development skills
+ Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
+ Strong solution/product build skills
+ Strong project management skills


* Human Skills –
+ Excellent written \& oral communication \& articulation
+ Flexible work attitude
+ Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
+ Strong collaboration skills
+ Ability to comprehend complexity quickly \& apply solutions
+ Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
+ Strong entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem \& solutions
+ Strong problem solving skills
+ Ability to perform effectively under pressure and deliver results
+ Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate or MBA with 2\-6 years of relevant experience
* Experience in end\-to\-end implementation of Workiva solution in Financial Reporting, ESG and GRC space.
* Experience in current state analysis (As is), future state analysis (To be), process optimization, process documentation, data integration, and data analytics
* Strong communication, team building, teaming and presentation experience
* Experience in SQL and system integration
* Experience with ETL tools (Power BI, Alteryx)
* Experience in leading and developing team
* Demonstrated problem solving and critical thinking skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments/responsibilities
* Experience and certified with Workiva solution.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**

title: Export Documentation and Operations - Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 S.P. Yarns is a privately held group of companies based in India, engaged for over three decades in the export of raw cotton, cotton waste, yarns, and fabrics. The organization has built long\-term partnerships across the textile value chain and is known for its focus on quality and reliability in global trade. With team members located in countries such as Colombia, Peru, Bangladesh, and Vietnam, S.P. Yarns operates with a strong international footprint. The company aims to further expand its global presence in the coming years, offering opportunities for professionals interested in international operations and export management.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Export Documentation and Operations – Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kolkata. This role is responsible for managing end\-to\-end export documentation, including preparation and verification of commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, LC documentation, and shipping documents in line with regulatory and customer requirements. The manager coordinates with shipping lines, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal production and sales teams to ensure timely dispatch of consignments and smooth export operations. Day\-to\-day tasks include monitoring shipment schedules, tracking containers, resolving documentation or logistics issues, and ensuring compliance with international trade regulations and company policies. The role also involves maintaining accurate records, optimizing operational processes, and providing regular status updates and reports to leadership.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong expertise in export documentation and international trade procedures, including familiarity with letters of credit, Incoterms, and customs requirements.
* Experience in logistics and supply chain coordination, preferably within textiles, yarns, fabrics, or related manufacturing and export environments.
* Proficiency in working with MS Office tools and documentation software; comfort with maintaining digital records and spreadsheets.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in paperwork and compliance.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills for coordinating with cross\-functional teams and external partners.
* Ability to work independently on\-site in Kolkata, handle multiple shipments simultaneously, and make timely operational decisions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, International Trade, Logistics, or a related field; advanced certifications in export\-import management are an advantage.
* Prior experience in export operations or documentation management in a managerial or supervisory capacity is strongly preferred.

The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for people with expertise in
 **Oracle GRC Senior Consultant** 
 to join our
 **EY\-GDS GRC Technology Team** 
 . This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Reviews materials and supports in meetings and workshops with business stakeholders to understand and gather business / functional requirements, undertaking client assessments and building relationships with business stakeholder.
* Builds relationships and collaborates with the wider team to understand business requirements and translates these into complex technical requirements.
* Produces technical specifications to guide system architectural design and development and conducts quality assurance tasks to ensure completeness of requirements, peer reviewing the work of more junior members of the team.
* Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and forms recommendations for system and technical components based on understanding of business requirements, reviewing and supporting with process modelling and improvement.
* Contributes to the design and review of test cases to ensure tests adequately meet the requirements and coordinates with infrastructure and operations teams to resolve system issues, contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project.
* Provides insights on whether solutions and technologies being implemented are meeting business requirements.
* Contributes to business case development and completes RFP responses, exploring and experimenting with new and existing data to tackle defined business problems .


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.
* Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 3 to 7 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
* Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:
* 
+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role\-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre\-requisite.
* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions .
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power\-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk \& Compliance) \& Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

title: Science Communicator on contract (Physics, Chemistry and Medicine)
description:
Editage \- Digital Media Solutions (DMS) works with scientists, universities, organizations, societies, and publishers across more than 150 accounts from around the world to visualize and disseminate their work. Through our content writing and design services, we convert complex scientific ideas into engaging content and visuals tailored to different audiences.
 



  





 We are seeking writers to develop high\-quality academic multimedia content. The role involves distilling technical source material into engaging narratives and creating storyboards for outputs such as graphical abstracts, infographics, and videos.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 




  




* Apply critical thinking and analytical skills to interpret published manuscripts and extract key insights, while ensuring that all content is scientifically accurate.
* Conceptualizing scientific concepts and heavy data into visual representations.
* Develop detailed storyboards with content, graphic guidance, and graphic references for designers.
* Creating scripts for video narrations.
* Creating articles, summaries, social media posts, and other content, which may include desk research to supplement content, sourcing peer\-reviewed scientific articles and citing references correctly.



  





**Qualifications and Prerequisites** 




  




* Master's and above in Physics, Chemistry or Medicine.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze manuscripts and synthesize complex information.
* Strong command of academic writing, grammar, and communication.
* Proficiency in conducting desk research and referencing scientific literature.
* Excellent responsiveness, reliability, and communication skills.



  





**Essential Skills** 



* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Creative mindset for visual storytelling in academic contexts.
* Professionalism in team interactions and feedback incorporation (as and when needed).

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
**About the role:** 





 Zeltis works on communicating the Government of West Bengal’s schemes, initiatives, events and priority messages to the people of the State through simple, accessible video and graphic content.
 





 We are looking for a
 
**Senior Copywriter** 

 who can anchor the written word in that process. The job is to take policy; often dense, technical and written for administrators and turn it into language that a farmer in Purulia, a student in Siliguri and a homemaker in Howrah can easily understand. This is not advertising for its own sake; it is public communication and it carries the weight and responsibility of the Government’s voice.
 





 The role is suited to someone who reads and analyzes the news out of genuine interest, who can tell the difference between a claim and a fact and who can write a line that lands without ever overstating or understating what the Government has actually said. 
 





 At Zeltis, we are looking for someone who brings curiosity, clarity and editorial judgement to every piece of content they write.
 




**Experience:** 

 3 to 5 years minimum prior experience as a content writer in governance, political, journalistic, research\-driven or critical/analytical environments. Candidates from newsrooms, policy institutions, think tanks, research organisations, editorial desks or long\-form publications will be strongly preferred, as the role demands accuracy and depth alongside creative flair.
 




**Key responsibilities:** 



* Translate scheme documents, policy notes, press releases and departmental briefs into clear, simple, people\-facing copy in Bengali and English.
* Write scripts (explainers, reels, testimonials, event films), voice\-over copy, graphic and creative copy, campaign taglines and punchlines.
* Produce copy that reads natively, with the idiom, rhythm and cultural texture appropriate to each, rather than a literal rendering of the other.
* Proactively ideate content and campaigns; identify communication opportunities before they are assigned and propose the narrative angle for them.
* Manage narrative consistently across campaigns and ensure the Government's initiatives are communicated positively, accurately and in a single coherent voice.
* Brief and work alongside the design, motion and video teams; ensure copy and visual treatment work together rather than in parallel.
* Deliver rapid\-response copy during announcements, events, launches and time\-sensitive situations.
* Act as the final quality check on outgoing copy to ensure factual accuracy, official nomenclature, scheme names, figures, spellings, grammar and tone.
* Guide and review the work of junior copywriters and maintain the unit's style and terminology standards.
* Maintain strict confidentiality on all unreleased communication, data and internal material.



**Essential skills and requirements:** 



* **Genuine understanding and interest in governance and policy:** 

 Demonstrable understanding of, knowledge of, or serious interest in governance, public policy and welfare delivery. Follows news \- State, local and National as a daily habit and can hold an informed conversation about the same.
* **Understands the sensitivity of government communication:** 

 Understands that government communication is not just another brand of communication. Appreciates the protocols, the factual discipline, the political and administrative sensitivities involved and the lines that must not be crossed. Exercises judgement about what can be said, how and when.
* **Simplification for the layman:** 

 Proven ability to convert technical, administrative and policy language into simple, everyday terms; copy that connects with a general audience across literacy levels, age groups and districts, without diluting or misrepresenting the facts.
* **Language command:** 

 Fluency in Bengali and English, publication\-standard writing, with the ability to write original copy. Hindi proficiency is optional but desirable.
* **Keen eye for detail and error identification:** 

 Catches factual slips, wrong figures, wrong scheme names, grammatical and typographical errors and inconsistencies in tone before anything goes out. A single error in government communication carries a disproportionate cost.
* **Creative writing and punchline ideation:** 

 Can produce memorable, sharp, quotable lines and headlines; slogans, hooks, taglines, captions that travel well on social platforms.
* **Proactive ideation and narrative management:** 

 Brings ideas to the table unprompted. Thinks in terms of campaigns and arcs, not one\-off posts and can shape a sustained positive narrative around the Government's work.
* **Availability and work commitment:** 

 Government work is unpredictable and often urgent. The role requires genuine willingness and enthusiasm to work beyond designated hours, including evenings, weekends and public holidays, when the situation demands.



**Good to have:** 



* Ad copywriting experience: Experience in writing campaign copy, print, OOH, digital and film.
* Agency experience: Familiarity with client servicing, brief\-taking, deadline culture and working within a creative team.
* Creative writing credentials: Published work, long\-form storytelling, literary or scripting background.
* Working knowledge of social media platform policies: Community guidelines, content restrictions and compliance requirements across Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube and WhatsApp.
* Understanding of platform algorithms: What drives reach, retention and engagement and how copy choices affect distribution.



  





**Remuneration: I** 

 ndustry standard, commensurate with experience, portfolio and interview performance
 




***This is an on\-site role and the candidate must travel to and work from the office***




  





***Applicants are requested to apply at***
*hr@zeltis.co.in* 
***along with submission of any one assignments mentioned below (Pick any one):***



1. *There is a lot of negative publicity surrounding Annapurna Yojana owing to the delay in payments. Even though the reason is logical administratively speaking, common people do not understand that. Hence, your task is to prepare a one\-minute content script for a video that will be published through Government or Department page; positively promoting the Annapurna Yojana which is not misleading \[in Bengali]*
2. *Write a video script on PM Surya Ghar Yojana with the intention of urging people to apply for the scheme through listing out its benefits. Common people find it boring to look through the pages of scheme documents, guidelines and websites; hence write the script in a manner like it appeals to the layman with the lucrative side of the scheme; without any half information or misinformation \[in Bengali]*

title: Project Engineer - Seat Development
description:
Role Title: Project Engineer – Seat Development
 



 Location: Kolkata
 



 Department: Product Development / R\&D
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 Role Summary \- We are looking for someone who can own the entire lifecycle of a seat: concept → design → development → validation → certification → customer handling → vendor management → tooling → final delivery. This role is for someone who can take a seat from a rough idea on paper to a fully certified, customer\-approved product ready for production. The person should be able to interact confidently with OEMs, vendors, testing agencies, and internal teams. They will handle design, development, documentation, certification, costing, and timelines end\-to\-end.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Key Responsibilities**



  





 1\) Product Design \& Engineering
 



  




* Understand customer requirements, technical standards, and application needs (Automotive, Railways, Defence, Marine, etc.).
* Create concept designs, 2D drawings, 3D models, BOM, and specifications.
* Select materials, mechanisms, foam compositions, trims, and structural components.
* Ensure manufacturability, durability, ergonomics, and safety compliance.



  





 2\) Customer Interaction \& Project Ownership
 



  




* Attend customer meetings, collect technical inputs, and translate them into design actions.
* Present concepts, drawings, prototypes, and test results to clients.
* Manage timelines, technical queries, and revisions.
* Ensure customer satisfaction from kick\-off till SOP (start of production).



  





 3\) New Product Development (NPD)
 



  




* Develop prototypes, coordinate with in\-house teams and external vendors.
* Plan and execute trials, fitments, and pilot builds.
* Generate DVP (Design Validation Plan), DFMEA, PFMEA, and related NPD documents.
* Improve designs based on testing, feedback, and production learnings.



  





 4\) Certification \& Compliance
 



  




* Coordinate for testing and certification with agencies like – ARAI / VRDE / ICAT / RDSO / DGQA / Navy / DGCA (depending on seat type).
* Prepare documentation needed for homologation or qualification.
* Ensure compliance with relevant standards (AIS, BIS, RDSO manuals, etc.).
* Track certification timelines and manage corrective actions, if any.



  





 6\) Documentation \& Reporting
 



  




* Maintain project timelines, revision history, ECNs, drawing releases.
* Prepare project tracker reports for management and customer reviews.
* Maintain clear documentation for smooth handover to production.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Degree in Mechanical / Automobile Engineering.
* 6–8 years of experience in automotive or seating industry.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong knowledge of 3D CAD tools (SolidWorks / Creo / Catia).
* Experience with mechanisms, kinematics, ergonomics, and material selection.
* Understanding of testing, certification, and industry standards.
* Good communication skills for customer\-facing discussions.
* Ability to handle multiple projects and deliver under timelines.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Hands\-on approach
* Curious mindset and problem\-solving attitude
* Comfort in visiting customer sites and vendor locations
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ownership mentality — “finish what you start”



  





**Why Join?** 




  




* Opportunity to build world\-class seating solutions across automotive, railway, marine, and defence sectors.
* Direct exposure to end\-to\-end development, not just one piece of the puzzle.
* Freedom to innovate and implement your ideas.

* Identify relevant consumer trends, cultural moments, health/wellness conversations and occasions that the brands can participate in.
* Build recurring and ownable content formats rather than relying only on topical or product\-led posts.
* Develop content themes across Ayurveda, health, wellness, beauty, lifestyle, nutrition, FMCG and preventive healthcare.



**2\. Social Media Content Management** 



* Own ideation and copy development across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Develop monthly content calendars, post concepts, captions, carousel stories, Reels/Shorts ideas, product communication, educational content, engagement content and moment marketing.
* Adapt communication by platform, audience and objective rather than replicating the same content across channels.
* Work with social, design and video teams to ensure content is execution\-ready and delivered on time.



**3\. Short\-form Content** 



* Develop concepts and scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, influencer content, UGC videos, performance ads, product demonstrations, expert\-led videos and testimonials.
* Create strong hooks and scripts using a clear structure such as Hook \> Story \> Product Integration \> Benefit \> CTA.
* Simplify health, wellness and product benefits into engaging, consumer\-friendly communication.



**4\. Long\-form Content** 



* Develop and/or manage website content, product pages, blogs, SEO articles, campaign landing pages, brand stories, educational articles and product education.
* Create marketplace A\+ content, brochures, catalogues, longer video scripts, leadership/founder communication, thought\-leadership content and CRM/WhatsApp/Email communication.
* Maintain factual accuracy while ensuring the language remains simple, relevant and engaging for the intended audience.



**5\. Creative Ideation \& Copywriting** 



* Work closely with designers and creative teams to develop campaign key visuals, headlines, taglines, digital ads, performance creatives, marketplace banners, website banners, POSM and BTL communication.
* Contribute to packaging communication and print communication where required.
* Operate as an ideator, not only as a copywriter receiving briefs: originate the idea and then work with design/video teams to bring it alive.



**6\. Brand Tonality Management** 




**Baidyanath Ayurveda:** 
 Trust, heritage, Ayurveda expertise, efficacy, family wellness, preventive healthcare and credibility. The communication should make a legacy Ayurvedic brand feel contemporary and relevant without losing its authority.
 



**Goodcare:** 
 Modern, digital\-forward, conversational, younger, lifestyle\-oriented, benefit\-driven and social\-first.
 



**7\. Campaign Development** 



* Partner with the cross\-functional team on new product launches, seasonal campaigns, category\-building, product education, influencer campaigns, performance campaigns, marketplace campaigns, festive campaigns and brand\-building initiatives.
* Translate one central campaign thought into multiple formats across social, video, digital, commerce and offline touchpoints.



**8\. Content Calendar, Governance \& Coordination** 



* Develop and manage monthly and quarterly content calendars with visibility of upcoming campaigns, business priorities and product launches.
* Coordinate with activation, social, design, performance, e\-commerce, marketplace, product/R\&D and agency teams.
* Maintain consistency in messaging and tonality across touchpoints and keep a repository of approved content, product claims and creative assets.
* Track performance of major content formats and use learnings to improve future communication.



**9\. Performance \& Commerce Content** 



* Develop communication for Meta ads, Google/YouTube creatives, marketplace ads, D2C website campaigns, retargeting, problem\-solution communication and promotional campaigns.
* Understand the difference between Brand Content, Engagement Content, Performance Content and Commerce Content, and tailor the writing accordingly.



**10\. Trend \& Competition Tracking** 



* Regularly study digital\-first FMCG, wellness, beauty and D2C brands to identify emerging formats, consumer language, category trends and creative opportunities.
* Bring relevant learnings into Baidyanath and Goodcare without copying competitor communication.



**Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 8\-10 years of experience in content, creative strategy, copywriting, digital content or brand communication.
* Preferably from a digital/creative agency environment handling FMCG, Health \& Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Nutrition or D2C brands.
* Alternatively, strong brand\-side experience with a digitally driven consumer brand.
* Prior experience on social\-first and/or D2C brands is strongly preferred.



**Must\-Have Skills** 



* Excellent written English with strong command over headlines, hooks and short\-form copy.
* Ability to simplify complex health/product information without diluting the core benefit.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn and digital\-first consumer communication.
* Experience writing short\-form video scripts and developing campaign ideas beyond executional copy.
* Strong storytelling, presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple brands and projects simultaneously.
* Comfort working closely with designers, editors, agencies, social teams and performance teams.
* Strong attention to detail and brand consistency.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Understanding of Ayurveda, wellness, nutrition, beauty or healthcare categories.
* Knowledge of Hindi and/or Bengali will be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of SEO and marketplace content such as Amazon A\+.
* Understanding of influencer, UGC and performance content.
* Ability to interpret basic social and content performance metrics.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* An ideator first and writer second.
* Naturally curious about brands, consumers, culture and digital trends.
* Comfortable generating multiple creative routes for one brief.
* Able to spot a strong hook, campaign thought or storytelling angle.
* Equally comfortable writing a five\-word headline and a long\-form article.
* Capable of challenging repetitive or predictable content.
* Commercially aware and understands that content must support brand and business growth.



**This is not a role for someone whose experience is primarily limited to SEO blogs or generic social\-media captions.** 




**The candidate should be able to answer: “What should the brand say, why should the consumer care, and what is the most interesting way to say it?”** 




**Key Deliverables / KPIs** 



* Quality and originality of content ideas and campaign thinking.
* Improvement in social engagement and overall content effectiveness.
* Quality of short\-form video concepts and scripts.
* Consistency and distinctiveness of Baidyanath and Goodcare brand tonality.
* Timeliness of content planning and delivery.
* Reduction in repetitive/generic communication.
* Contribution to product launches, digital campaigns and commerce requirements.
* Ability to convert marketing briefs into execution\-ready creative ideas.



**Portfolio Requirement** 




 Candidates should submit a portfolio containing examples of:
 


* Social media campaigns and content properties
* Reels / short\-form video scripts
* Campaign concepts and key creative ideas
* Headlines / digital advertisements
* Long\-form writing
* Brand launches or integrated campaigns
